press_references.value: Valu Expands Travel Fintech Offering Through Strategic Partnership with Wego

partnership_announcements.description: Valu and Wego formed a strategic partnership integrating Valu’s flexible financing into Wego’s travel marketplace in Egypt, enabling travelers to pay for flights and accommodation via installment plans of up to 60 months.

press_references.value: Valu Jordan and Network International Jordan launch strategic partnership to expand "Buy Now, Pay Later" solutions

partnership_announcements.description: Valu Jordan and Network International Jordan have signed a strategic partnership to integrate Valu's buy now, pay later services across Network International’s merchant network in Jordan, enabling BNPL at physical and online points of sale via NI’s POS terminals and QR-based digital flows.

press_references.value: Valu enables seamless digital onboarding on Dubai Phone App, expanding access to instant BNPL services in Egypt

partnership_announcements.description: Valu and Dubai Phone entered a new partnership to integrate Valu’s BNPL financing and fully digital onboarding into the Dubai Phone mobile app, enabling instant, paperless account activation and embedded financing at checkout for customers in Egypt.

press_references.value: Valu partners with Newgiza Sports Club to support their water polo teams

partnership_announcements.description: Valu formed a new sponsorship partnership with Newgiza Sports Club to support and sponsor NGSC’s water polo teams, aligning Valu’s brand with athlete development and Egyptian sports growth.

press_references.value: Valu partners with Voltة to make locally manufactured green neighborhood EVs accessible in Egypt

partnership_announcements.description: Valu and Voltة announced a strategic partnership to offer flexible financing plans for Voltة’s locally manufactured neighborhood electric vehicles in Egypt.

press_references.value: Valu and TimeOut Sports & Entertainment partner to offer exclusive FIFA World Cup 2026 hospitality packages

partnership_announcements.description: Valu and TimeOut Sports & Entertainment formed a strategic partnership to let Egyptian fans buy FIFA World Cup 2026 hospitality packages using Valu-powered installment payment plans.

press_references.value: Valu renews partnership with Amazon Egypt to expand seamless financing solutions

partnership_announcements.description: Valu renewed its partnership with Amazon Egypt to expand embedded financing options for Amazon.eg shoppers, signaling an enhanced BNPL offering.

press_references.value: Valu and noon Launch Egypt’s First Licensed Digital Onboarding for BNPL Payments

partnership_announcements.description: Valu and e-commerce marketplace noon announced a partnership to launch Egypt’s first licensed BNPL digital onboarding within noon’s app under the FRA FinTech License, enabling instant eKYC and e-signature signup at checkout.

press_references.value: ValU Secures CBOJ Nod to Launch BNPL Services in Jordan

partnership_announcements.description: Valu has announced new partnerships with local merchants and financial institutions in Jordan to support the launch of its BNPL services.
